learning_outcomes.text: To acquaint the students with basic terms and tools used in quality management systems.

syllabus_topics: Product Life Cycle and Quality, Development of QMS
Quality management systems - normative and strategic programs
Basic statistical terms, continuous and discrete distributions, production stability
Modern quality control technologies, CMM and CMS
Functional principles of measuring sensors and their application
Acceptance and verification testing of CMM
Capability of process Cp, Cpk, and capability of gauge Cg, Cgk
Fundamentals of data processing, histogram, Pareto analysis.
Failure Mode and Effects Analysis - FMEA.
bibliography: Quality Control For Dummies, Published by Wiley Publishing, Inc.
Six Sigma for Dummies,Published by Wiley Publishing, Inc.
Statistical Quality Control, Douglas C. Montgomery
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
